answer: Give every identity a witness, not a wallet: each epoch you are assigned one peer whose actions you must record in a signed running ledger, a ledge of hashes extended daily, while a stranger records yours. Auditors randomly cross-check paired ledgers; a mismatch voids both records that epoch. A farm invents clones cheaply, but it cannot invent many mutually consistent witness histories for events that never happened, because fabrication must survive every cross-check. Honest recording is just copying what passed the willow at the haven; forged history costs grow with each pair checked.
